> Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure.
> Trusted by the U.S. Department of War and Fortune 500s, our platform runs on-premises and in private clouds, delivering secure messaging, file sharing, workflow automation, audio/screenshare, and project management—all with full data and operational control.

# Why Mattermost
[under: Why Mattermost] - Mission-driven work: Your contributions directly support the organizations and missions that depend on secure, reliable collaboration including the U.S. Department of War and critical infrastructure operators worldwide
[under: Why Mattermost] - Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere with a globally distributed, high-trust team built for autonomy and ownership
[under: Why Mattermost] - AI-forward environment: We actively adopt and build AI-enabled workflows. Agentic development is core craft here, not a novelty
…
[under: Why Mattermost] Target Salary Range: $142,723- $172,723
[under: Why Mattermost] Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay and pay may vary depending on your location.
[under: Why Mattermost] The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions.
[under: Why Mattermost] These ranges may be modified in the future.
[under: Why Mattermost] Mattermost offers a remote-first work environment with medical, dental, and vision coverage.
[under: Why Mattermost] You’ll also receive unlimited PTO plus company holidays, a work from home stipend, an annual learning and development budget for conferences, certifications, and courses, paid parental leave for all parents, and a 401(k) plan.
# U.S. Eligibility & Compliance
[under: U.S. Eligibility & Compliance] This role may require obtaining and maintaining a U.S. government security clearance.
[under: U.S. Eligibility & Compliance] Candidates must meet federal eligibility requirements to be considered.
[under: U.S. Eligibility & Compliance] For more information visit Security Clearances — United States Department of State
[under: U.S. Eligibility & Compliance] Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for access to export-controlled information as defined by U.S. export control laws, including EAR and ITAR.
[under: U.S. Eligibility & Compliance] For more information visit the Bureau of Industry and Security and the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.
> Mattermost is an EEO Employer, we are a remote-first, open-source company.
> We are continually working to expand our hiring in more countries and regions, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations, which takes time.
> Mattermost values your unique perspective—we welcome all applicants.
> We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to assessing candidates based on their skills and qualifications.
> We do not tolerate discrimination against staff or applicants based on race, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other personal characteristics.
> If you require accommodations during the interview process, please let us know—we’re happy to assist.

title: Senior Data Engineer
options: Switzerland [remote]
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps.
Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Engineer based in Switzerland.
As a Senior Data Engineer, you will take ownership of the data platform, shaping its architecture and ensuring reliable performance from development through production.
…
Working with technologies such as Python, PostgreSQL, dbt, and Google Cloud Platform, you will integrate external data sources and AI-powered extraction capabilities.
This fully remote opportunity offers broad technical ownership, the freedom to shape foundational data infrastructure, and the chance to make a direct impact in a collaborative, fast-moving engineering environment.
# Accountabilities
…
[under: Accountabilities] - Establish Raw-to-Curated Data Architecture: Preserve original source payloads, including provider JSON, in Google Cloud Storage (GCS), then transform and standardize data using dbt. Maintain clearly defined raw, standardized, and curated data layers.
[under: Accountabilities] - Strengthen Data Quality and Governance: Define data contracts, automated validation rules, pipeline tests, retention policies, and monitoring systems to track data freshness, processing failures, and overall reliability.
[under: Accountabilities] - Optimize Database Performance: Design and maintain PostgreSQL schemas, queries, and incremental loading strategies to ensure efficient processing and dependable data delivery to downstream products.
[under: Accountabilities] - Integrate Enrichment and AI Extraction: Incorporate third-party enrichment providers and large language model (LLM)-based structured extraction from text into the data platform.
[under: Accountabilities] - Ensure Data Traceability: Maintain clear lineage between source data and curated records, enabling safe reprocessing, historical recovery, auditing, and consistent data management.
…
[under: Requirements] - Workflow Orchestration: Hands-on production experience with Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Temporal, including workflow dependencies, retries, scheduling, and failure recovery. Airflow experience is preferred.
[under: Requirements] - Google Cloud and dbt: Practical production experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and dbt, including data transformation, pipeline management, and cloud-based data infrastructure.
[under: Requirements] - Event-Driven Architecture: Experience developing asynchronous, event-driven systems using messaging platforms or task queues, with a strong understanding of concurrent processing, retries, and fault tolerance.
…
[under: Requirements] - SQL and PostgreSQL: Advanced SQL knowledge and practical PostgreSQL experience, including data modeling, query optimization, incremental loading, and performance tuning.
[under: Requirements] - Data Quality and Modeling: Experience designing data contracts, raw and curated storage layers, retention policies, automated validation, and data quality monitoring.
[under: Requirements] - Web Scraping Expertise: Hands-on experience building and maintaining production scraping pipelines using tools such as Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, or Beautiful Soup, including concurrency management, rate limiting, and failure handling.
…
[under: Requirements] - Entity Resolution: Familiarity with matching company and individual records across multiple sources, identifying duplicates, and consolidating information into consistent entities is highly desirable.
[under: Requirements] - LLM-Based Data Processing: Experience using large language models for structured data extraction, company enrichment, or people data enrichment is an advantage.
[under: Requirements] - Additional Data Technologies: Familiarity with BigQuery and Dataform is a plus.
…

[under: Benefits] - Fully remote work: Work remotely from eligible locations across Europe and Latin America, with flexibility to organize your working environment.
[under: Benefits] - Technical ownership: Lead the architecture and evolution of a data platform, with meaningful influence over technical decisions and engineering practices.
…
[under: Benefits] - Engineering autonomy: Take ownership of technical challenges and shape scalable solutions in a dynamic, product-focused environment.
[under: Benefits] - Innovation opportunities: Explore advanced data processing, entity resolution, external data enrichment, and LLM-based extraction techniques.
[under: Benefits] - International collaboration: Work with a distributed team across multiple regions, with opportunities to contribute to evolving technical initiatives.
